Shipping & returns

Fast delivery from Oslo, tax-free shopping outside Norway and 14 days to change your mind.

Delivery

DestinationCarrierDelivery time
NorwayPosten2–5 business days
EuropeUPS International Economy2–5 business days
Rest of the worldUPS International Economy4–10 business days

Orders ship Monday to Friday; weekend orders ship the next business day. In Norway, Posten delivers to your local pick-up point and notifies you by SMS or email.

Prices, VAT & duties

All prices are in NOK and include 25% Norwegian VAT. Customers outside Norway shop tax-free. Import duties and local taxes, where they apply, are paid by the customer.

Returns & exchanges

  • Return or exchange within 14 days of delivery.
  • Items must be in perfect condition with tags and seal attached.
  • Size exchanges are processed when we receive your return, subject to stock.
  • Refunds go back to the original payment method. Return shipping is paid by the customer.
  • The same policy applies during sales.

Send returns to: Closetoskin, Nordengveien 23b, 0755 Oslo, Norway. Need help? Email info@closetoskin.com.

FAQ

How long does delivery take?
Orders ship Monday to Friday. Delivery takes 2–5 days within Norway and Europe and 4–10 days to the rest of the world. Norwegian orders ship with Posten, international orders with UPS.
Can I shop tax-free from outside Norway?
Yes. Our prices include 25% Norwegian VAT. Customers outside Norway shop tax-free, but are responsible for any import duties and taxes in their own country.
What is your return and exchange policy?
You can return or exchange items within 14 days of delivery, as long as they are in perfect condition with tags and seal attached. We happily exchange to a different size, subject to stock. Return shipping is paid by the customer.
What are your underwear made of?
Our underwear is made from natural fibres: wool & silk blends (85/15 and 70/30), pure 100% silk, and a cotton, wool & silk blend. The exact composition is listed on every product page.
How do I choose my size?
Our underwear comes in S, M and L with a close, second-skin fit. If you are between sizes or prefer a looser layer, choose the larger size. You can always exchange within 14 days.
How do I care for wool and silk?
Hand wash in cool water with a mild wool or silk detergent, don't wring, and dry flat away from direct heat. Always follow the care label on the garment.
